title: What can you say about chamomile (German) in your ads and on your site?
summary: The library supports 2 wordings for chamomile (German); the strongest is "Traditionally used in herbal medicine to help relieve mild, occasional digestive upset such as gas, bloating and belching" (limited, 1.5-24 g dried flower (or extract equivalent) a day). Avoid wording that names or implies a disease, a drug or a treatment, such as "Treats anxiety".
